step3.title: TOU pricing
step3.noRules: No rate windows defined — every booking uses the base price. Click Add rate window to start.

step4.title: Availability & Operational Standards
step4.lockDesc: The check-in window ends at the deadline saved on each booking (15 minutes before the end time by default). A booking not checked in by that deadline is handled as a no-show.
step4.advanceDesc: A booking may start today or tomorrow in Vietnam time. This is a calendar-day limit, not a rolling 48-hour window from now.
step4.validConfigHelp: Each booking is checked against system rules and stores the deadlines that apply to that booking.
step4.bufferDesc: Suggested time for the previous vehicle to unplug and leave safely. The system does not automatically insert a 10-minute gap between bookings.
step4.philosophyTitle: Core Operational Principles: Reservations & Real Charging Sessions
step4.philosophyBooking: Reservations are commitments: Guaranteed time slots with drivers. Early completions create safe buffers without advancing downstream schedules.
step4.philosophyBuffer: 10-minute gap is vehicle-turnaround guidance: It gives the previous vehicle time to unplug and leave safely; the system does not automatically enforce this gap.
step4.philosophyOverstay: A vehicle remains after its booking ends: Staff handle it through the operating process. The next booking keeps its confirmed time.
step4.philosophySchedule: Pricing and hours follow their effective dates: New bookings use the version effective for the requested time; confirmed bookings keep their saved snapshot.
step4.philosophyBookingText: Guaranteed time slots with drivers. Early completions create safe buffers without advancing downstream schedules.
step4.philosophyBufferText: This is operating guidance; the system does not automatically insert a 10-minute gap between bookings.
step4.philosophyOverstayBold: A vehicle remains after its booking ends:
step4.philosophyOverstayText: Staff handle it through the operating process. The next booking keeps its confirmed time.
step4.philosophyScheduleBold: Pricing and hours follow their effective dates:
